now.title: Echo#2
now.text: Lowak is one of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A descendant who sees Lowak's story in visions.
now.on_b_card_about_a: One of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, seen in visions.

changes.evidence: Lowak is a Choctaw tribeswoman in Alabama in 1200 AD, shown only in the Echo#2 cold open. Maya, centuries later, only receives visions of her ancestors (Echo#2, #4), and visions are not events between people. A blood tie never met; nothing on screen implies they know each other.

owner_calls.question: John Walker and Steve Rogers never meet (the stage text says so); Walker only admires Steve and inherits the Captain America mantle after Sam gives up the shield. Keep under the huge-consequences exception, or drop as knowing about a legend?
owner_calls.evidence: In The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#1-2 the government names Walker the new Captain America using the shield Sam donated; Steve gave the shield to Sam in Avengers: Endgame. Walker praises Steve on Good Morning America but they never meet on screen.
